description: This file is a test script for the Thunder Plugin OCIContainer, implementing WebSocket communication, invoking container management methods, and handling events to test container lifecycle operations.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a timestamped message to the console.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the server.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and processes the response, with optional timeout and response check.

methods.name: waitEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event from the WebSocket stream with optional timeout and check.
